caption: The drawing shows a circular or oval scene bordered in gray and black, which encloses a landscape with two large, stylized birds facing each other. The birds are rendered with patterns of pale gray, lavender, and reddish-brown, with detailed feathers and long tails extending to each side. Behind and between the birds stand several slender, leafless trees in pale pink and brown tones, while in the background there are dark, abstract shapes representing distant trees or bushes. The sky is suggested with a muted blue color. Below the birds, a horizontal black band separates the upper composition from a lower section that contains curved, organic shapes in shades of gray, lavender, and brown, resembling rocks or roots, with hints of foliage. To the lower right of the main scene, there is a small rectangular inset containing an arrangement of leaves and grapes in green, white, and brown. The entire drawing is centered on a light tan background, and a faint signature is visible near the inset in the lower right corner.
title: Bandbox Cover
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
